description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {R}.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Priest of Urabrask on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from the top of your library by paying {2}{R}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
